scripts.build: npm run build -w @fieldboard/contracts && npm run build -w @fieldboard/api && npm run build -w @fieldboard/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fieldboard/contracts && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fieldboard/contracts && npm run test -w @fieldboard/contracts && npm run test -w @fieldboard/api && npm run test -w @fieldboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fieldboard/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fieldboard/api && npm run typecheck -w @fieldboard/web
